patch_description: This crossover retains the current program’s population-based smooth minimax search and exact accepted-step polishing, while incorporating the inspiration program’s adaptive moment-reset schedule. Resetting Adam moments when the soft-contact sharpness crosses important beta levels prevents stale broad-phase momentum from degrading late minimax refinement. The high-beta learning-rate reductions and longer second-moment memory stabilize the sparse-contact regime, improving both efficiency and reliability of the final packing polish.
